item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 29/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Mawar will turn northwards gradually and move slowly in the next couple of days. It will linger around seas east of Taiwan and then move in the general direction of the Ryukyu Islands. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, it will be persistently very hot over the coast of southern China in the next few days. Showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong during the weekend.
